description: This is a PHP class named VacancyDecorator that provides methods to manipulate Vacancy objects, such as setting related entities like JobTitle and Employee by their IDs, and checking if the vacancy is active and published.

classes.name: VacancyDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Vacancy entity that adds utility methods to set related entities and check vacancy status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a specific Vacancy object.

methods.name: setJobTitleById
methods.description: Sets the JobTitle for the vacancy using a provided ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeById
methods.description: Sets the hiring manager of the vacancy using a provided Employee ID.

methods.name: isActiveAndPublished
methods.description: Checks if the vacancy is both published and active.
